tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Adequacy of the Proposed Work plan and Methodology in responding to the TOR.
Consultant Registration Certificate, a valid ISO 9001 certificate as consultancy services provider from Government approved / registered Firm.
Experience in providing TPIA& auditing services in Karnataka.
Financial Turn over certificate as mentioned in Bid document.
Qualifications and Competence of the key professional staff as mentioned in the bid document
The firm/ agency/ institution must have registered under Companies Registration Act or Societies Act. The registration certificates shall be submitted.
Work done certificate as mentioned in Bid Document.
